transcript.text: Thank you, Ravi and Tessa. Let me tie the legal implications together. With the $2,000,000 in court-documentation-dependent accounts excluded, the transferred face balance drops from $30,000,000 to $28,000,000. At the buyer's offered 94%, the settlement amount would adjust accordingly. The assignment notices for the remaining loans must go out 15 days before closing, which means we cannot settle this month unless those notices are sent immediately — and Maya, that borrower-notification timeline is a hard legal requirement, not a discretionary term. Ravi, the pseudonymization and data-room approval conditions you described will need to be built into the assignment-notice process as well, since borrower records will be part of what gets transferred. Tessa, the final loan tape for your DVP timeline will need to reflect the reduced $28,000,000 pool. I'll prioritize getting my memo out of legal review and circulated today so everyone has the documentation. Maya, given the 15-day notice requirement, I'd recommend we assess immediately whether this month's settlement is still feasible or whether we need to negotiate a new timeline with the buyer.
